name: Block Title HTML Element
description: Lets admins pick, per block, the HTML element (h2-h6, span, p, em, b, i) that wraps the block's title, from a fixed allowlist; defaults to strong.
project_description: Block title HTML element allows users to choose the HTML element used by block titles through the block's configuration interface. A per-block third-party setting exposes a title_element Twig variable (h2-h6, span, p, em, b, i, or the strong default) after the theme's block.html.twig is updated to render it; a small validator service enforces a strict tag allowlist at form-submit, presave, and render time.
